::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [4 April 1872?]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear Miss Sewell,
Will not this do? The M.S is come?

Hoping for you on the 25th

Yours affectionately
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** An envelope, which may go with this note, is  postmarked Winchester 4 Ap 17 72, and addressed to  “Miss E M Sewell/Bonchurch/I of Wight”.  Otherwise it seems more likely that the note dates from their collaboration in 1867-8.
